```plato

//==
// # 3D joints
//
// The spatial joint zoo (hinges, ball-sockets, sliders, welds, ropes,
// springs, pulleys, the configurable six-degree-of-freedom joint, and gear
// coupling) plus the ragdoll wiring that groups them. BodyA and BodyB are
// zero-based indices into the simulation's body array; -1 attaches that side
// to the static world. Anchors, axes, and frames are expressed in the owning
// body's local frame, in meters. (Skeletal animation owns the bare name Bone;
// every type here is *Joint- or *Constraint-suffixed.)

// A one-degree-of-freedom rotational joint (door hinge, wheel axle). The
// bodies rotate relative to each other only about the axis through the
// anchors; AxisA and AxisB are the hinge axis in each body's local frame.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revolute_joint)
type HingeJoint
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    AnchorA: Point3D;
    AnchorB: Point3D;
    AxisA: Direction3D;
    AxisB: Direction3D;
    Limit: AngularLimit;
    Motor: JointMotor;
}
```
